change_reason: Unchanged procedural aircraft shape, dimensions, materials, canopy, control surfaces and propeller; pool IDs are kept outside the factory.
Unchanged geometry/material batching; the factory owns source resources and the batch cache owns merged geometry.
Unchanged sea geometry and wave coefficients for presentation; Uchiotose fatal sea plane remains y=0 under R07.
Unchanged sky, water, sun and haze shaders; no external images, fonts or audio assets.
Unchanged one-fence GPU queue and 1 second in-flight stall policy; loading warm-up behavior is adapted in WorldRenderer.

Same aerodynamic equations, 65/110/141 m/s baseline envelope, 18 m/s² throttle trim, 5 second loop and 2 second cooldown. Plain numeric vector/quaternion adapter; ice affects displacement and speed-dependent turn authority once.
Only fixed flight input/controller contracts retained; excluded bombs, torpedoes, source mission rules and source combat entity types.
Same 64 degree FOV, (0,11,29) chase offset, 45% camera bank and fixed Normal/Easy look. Numeric adapter and entity handoff reset; no render FPS enters simulation.
Retained Easy steering/camera response and 35%/0.028/0.16 rad correction and 1200 m auto-fire gate; winged warrior targets provide actual velocity and are filtered by island sight.
Retained 500 m manual bore convergence and projection, adapted to numeric poses.
Same 1.5 px core, 2.5 px outline, 0.045 s tail, depth test and fixed 2048 segment pool; new projectile record format and removal of source teams/legacy life counters.
Retained geometry-only 270.43 m hull stations, tapered keel and deckhouse solids; removed all source naval weapon rules, enemy ship scoring and independent gun HP.
Retained exact tapered hull span plane sweep and deckhouse union, adapted to plain vectors and moving friendly hulls. Independent new sphere/box/intercept helpers.
Static friendly fleet factory built from shared source hull stations/deckhouse solids and source major gun dimensions; logical AA is one battery per ship, shared geometry and bounded 10 ship roots.

Retained sea/sky/light/tone mapping/camera/aircraft control surface presentation and fixed GPU queue. Removed source ordnance and enemy ship rules; added original closed island/winged warriors, bounded new fire/ice/owner effects, roster IDs and root disposal. Hidden shared materials warm before first full-size Home frame; loading waits for genuine GPU completion within 30 seconds like source prepare; in-flight 1 second stall unchanged.
Retained sight radii/aim colors and radar role shapes; added island sight filtering and offscreen nearest-enemy arrow.

Flight/loop/throttle regression coverage combined with a golden fixture generated by executing fixed source flight.ts. Adds R07/R08/R09/R13 collision, spawn, boundary, free-flight, ice turn authority and ID-order tests.
